content_metadata.description: A narrative video promoting a scientific mission to land a spacecraft on a comet and investigate the origin of water on Earth.

qAndA.answer: The mission aims to land a spacecraft on a comet to study its composition and investigate the origin of water on Earth.
qAndA.question: What is the goal of the mission discussed in the video?

qAndA.answer: He is standing on a beach to visually represent the sand and water, which are believed to be key components of comets.

qAndA.answer: It marks the successful beginning of the mission to send the spacecraft to the comet.

qAndA.answer: They are celebrating the successful launch of the rocket and the commencement of their years-long research project.
qAndA.question: Why are the people in the office celebrating?

qAndA.answer: The video conveys a strong sense of excitement and anticipation, highlighting the scientific importance of the mission and the dedication of the team involved.

youtube_description:
+++ Update +++ 
Rosetta's lander Philae is safely on the surface of Comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko, as these first two CIVA images confirm. One of the lander's three feet can be seen in the foreground.

DLR's Rosetta special
http://www.dlr.de/en/rosetta
------------

Few things could be more fascinating or demanding in the history of European space travel than the Rosetta comet mission. Launched on 2 March 2004, the spacecraft set off on its 10-year journey to the comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko .
The lander, Philae, will separate from its parent craft on 12 November 2014, touch down on the comet and immediately fire harpoons to anchor itself on the surface. The two spacecraft will then accompany the comet on its month-long journey to the point at which it is closest to the Sun.

See the shortfilm “Landing on a Comet – The Rosetta Mission” (11 minutes) on 
http://www.dlr.de/dlr/en/desktopdefault.aspx/tabid-10081/151_read-11868/#/gallery/16729

Background Rosetta - Europe's comet chaser 
http://www.dlr.de/dlr/de/desktopdefault.aspx/tabid-10394/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5b7u6stKgfs&list=PLEDWnfmz-B8FJjRk7liyeNEvdeO3FdOPU

MISSION INS UNGEWISSE  II – Der Kometenlander Philae (TRAILER)
Die Kometen-Mission Rosetta ist eine der faszinierendsten und zugleich anspruchsvollsten Unternehmungen der europäischen Raumfahrt. Nach ihrem Start am 2. März 2004 trat die Sonde ihre zehnjährige Reise zum Kometen 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko an.
Am 12. November 2014 wird sich das Landegerät Philae vom Mutterschiff lösen, auf dem Kometen aufsetzen und sich sofort mit Harpunen im Eis verankern. Beide begleiten den Schweifstern auf seinem mehrmonatigen Weg zu seinem sonnennächsten Punkt.
